instruction: Open the instructor-embedding GitHub page at https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding in Chrome.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to Colab URL, read setup instructions, opened terminal, cloned instructor-embedding repo successfully, then started pip install -r requirements.txt but the download was extremely slow (torch ~915MB). Task timed out after 50 turns with pip install incomplete.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome to URLs, open terminal via Ctrl+Alt+T, run terminal commands (cd, git clone, pip install, cat), wait for long-running operations
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because the overall task required downloading ~1GB of packages (especially torch) over a very slow network connection. The git clone (174MB) alone took many turns. The pip install never completed within the 50-turn limit.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to just Chrome URL navigation, which the model demonstrated early in the trajectory when it successfully navigated to the Colab URL. This tests basic browser navigation capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating Chrome to a specific GitHub URL. Evaluator uses Chrome DevTools protocol (port 9222 via socat) to query open tabs and checks that the URL contains the expected repository path.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses Chrome DevTools Protocol (curl localhost:9222/json) to retrieve open tab information including URLs
Metric check_include_exclude correctly checks if the result string contains 'xlang-ai/instructor-embedding', which will appear in the DevTools JSON if the GitHub page is open
Expected value 'xlang-ai/instructor-embedding' is the correct repository path substring that uniquely identifies the target URL
Config properly launches Chrome with remote debugging port and socat forwarding, enabling the DevTools query
Single-step instruction is fully covered by the single evaluator check
